title: 形はなくとも手を伸ばす

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio has dropped out of the Kikuka Sho. As someone who looks up to her own "Emperor", Yamanin Zephyr is deeply shaken by the news.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm able to lift her spirits, however, by pointing out that there is a way she can encourage her friend—and that it's a way unique to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Zephyr heads to Teio's side and explains how her eyes were opened when she heard Teio declare her intent to surpass the Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Zephyr makes a declaration of her own—by winning a medium-distance race, she's going to become a triple-distance champion, a feat that not even the Mile Emperor could manage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There are some things Umamusume can only convey through their running. Zephyr asks Teio to come and watch her run in the Sprinters Stakes.
